Hydrogen-rich compounds hold promise as high-temperature superconductors under high pressures. Recent theoretical hydride structures on achieving high-pressure superconductivity are composed mainly of \mathbf { H _ { 2 } } fragments. Through a systematic investigation of Ca hydrides with different hydrogen contents using particleswam optimization structural search, we show that in the stoichiometry \mathsf { C a H _ { 6 } } a body-centered cubic structure with hydrogen that forms unusual“sodalite" cagescontainingenclathratedCa stabilizes above pressure 150 GPa. The stability of this structure is derived from the acceptance bytwo \mathbf { H _ { 2 } } of electrons donated by Ca forming an \mathbf { H _ { 4 } } unitas the building block in the construction of the three-dimensional sodalite cage. This unique structure has a partial occupationof thedegenerated orbitals at the zone center. The resultant dynamicJahn–Teller effecthelps to enhance electronphonon coupling and leads to superconductivity of \mathbf { C a H _ { 6 } } . A superconducting critical temperature ( \mathbf { I } _ { c } ) of 220–235 K at 150 GPa obtained from the solution of the Eliashberg equations is the highest among all hydrides studied thus far.

raw_result.reason: 原文明确给出在150 GPa、μ*=0.13时，通过求解Eliashberg方程得到Tc=220 K，而当前值235 K对应μ*=0.1的结果。当前记录中paired_mu_star为0.13，但value_number为235 K，与原文中μ*=0.13对应的220 K不一致。然而，摘要中给出Tc范围220–235 K，且当前记录未指定μ*为0.13时仍取235 K，存在条件不匹配。但根据原文，235 K是μ*=0.1时的结果，而记录中paired_mu_star为0.13，因此该值在给定μ*下不成立。不过，若将235 K视为摘要中范围的上限，则原文支持该数值，但需注意其对应的μ*应为0.1。
